art_direction: 浅蕨绿底雾靛双眼，间距略近，同向右看。
composition_variation: Bring the pair modestly closer while leaving a clear background gap. Keep the lower left eye eighteen percent shallower and the higher right eye a little wider. Both large black pupils attach to gently arched upper lids and shift together slightly right. Matching dusty denim bands curve beneath them and narrow toward the corners; one long thin ivory glint appears in each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
